learning: Event-driven learning updates a candidate model when authorized bars arrive. Labels mature after 48 hours. Champions stay frozen until prospective tests and explicit review pass.
limitations: No broker or licensed intraday feed is connected. Forex and derivatives need instrument-specific models. The bundled daily ORCL results do not validate this intraday profile.
